name: Spinach and Egg Scramble
steps: Wilt the spinach in butter then pour in beaten eggs and stir gently until just set.

name: Tomato Basil Pasta
steps: Boil the pasta and toss with garlic and tomatoes cooked down with basil and a little parmesan.

name: Mushroom Risotto-Style Rice
steps: Soften onion and mushrooms then simmer the rice with stock added a ladle at a time and finish with butter and parmesan.

name: Chicken and Veg Stir-Fry
steps: Fry the chicken then add sliced vegetables and finish with soy sauce and grated ginger.

name: Veggie Fried Rice
steps: Fry onion and carrot then add cold rice peas and a scrambled egg and season with soy sauce.

name: Cheesy Omelette
steps: Whisk eggs with a splash of milk and cook in a pan topped with grated cheddar.

name: Creamy Mushroom Pasta
steps: Saute mushrooms and garlic add cream and toss with pasta and parsley.

name: Chickpea and Spinach Curry
steps: Cook onion garlic and ginger then simmer with chickpeas tomatoes and coconut milk and stir in spinach.

name: Potato and Onion Frittata
steps: Fry sliced potato and onion then pour over eggs top with cheese and bake until set.

name: Tuna Pasta Salad
steps: Toss cooked cooled pasta with tuna chopped tomato cucumber and lemon juice.

name: Banana Oat Pancakes
steps: Blend banana oats egg and milk and fry small pancakes until golden.

name: Roasted Veg Tray Bake
steps: Chop all vegetables toss in oil and roast until browned at the edges.

name: Lentil Soup
steps: Simmer lentils with softened carrot onion garlic and tomatoes until tender.

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta
steps: Saute shrimp in garlic butter and toss with pasta lemon and parsley.

name: Salmon with Lemon and Broccoli
steps: Bake the salmon with lemon and butter and steam the broccoli alongside.

name: Black Bean Tacos
steps: Warm the beans and fill tortillas with avocado tomato and cilantro and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Caprese Toast
steps: Toast the bread and top with sliced tomato mozzarella and basil.

name: Yogurt and Banana Breakfast Bowl
steps: Layer yogurt sliced banana and oats.

name: Cauliflower Cheese Bake
steps: Make a quick cheese sauce with milk butter and cheddar pour over cauliflower and bake.

name: Sausage and Bean Stew
steps: Brown the sausage then simmer with onion pepper beans and tomatoes.

name: French Toast
steps: Soak bread in whisked egg and milk and fry in butter until golden.

name: Greek Salad
steps: Chop everything and toss with oil and a little vinegar.

name: Chicken Fajita Wraps
steps: Fry strips of chicken pepper and onion and serve in tortillas with yogurt.

name: Sweet Potato Soup
steps: Simmer vegetables in stock until soft then blend with coconut milk.

name: Egg Fried Noodle-Style Pasta
steps: Stir-fry shredded cabbage and garlic add cooked pasta and egg and season with soy sauce.

name: Zucchini Fritters
steps: Grate and squeeze the zucchini mix with egg onion and parmesan and fry spoonfuls.

name: Ham and Cheese Toastie
steps: Butter the bread fill with ham and cheese and toast in a pan.

name: Aubergine Parmigiana
steps: Layer roasted eggplant with tomato sauce and cheeses and bake until bubbling.

name: Quinoa Veggie Bowl
steps: Cook the quinoa and top with raw vegetables avocado and lemon.

name: Couscous with Roasted Veg
steps: Roast the vegetables soak couscous in hot stock and crumble over feta.

name: Bacon and Egg Fried Rice
steps: Crisp the bacon then fry with rice onion peas and egg.

name: Cabbage and Potato Hash
steps: Fry diced potato bacon and onion then add shredded cabbage until soft.

name: Peanut Noodle-Style Pasta
steps: Whisk peanut butter with soy sauce and warm water and toss with pasta and shredded vegetables.

name: Corn and Pea Fritters
steps: Mix thawed vegetables with egg and parmesan and fry small patties.

name: Tomato Soup with Grilled Cheese
steps: Simmer and blend tomato onion and garlic and serve with a cheese toastie.

name: Avocado Toast with Egg
steps: Mash avocado with lemon on toast and top with a fried egg.

name: Chicken and Rice Soup
steps: Simmer chicken with vegetables then shred the meat and add rice and parsley.

name: Shakshuka
steps: Simmer tomato pepper onion and garlic then crack in eggs and cook covered and top with feta.

name: Beef and Potato Skillet
steps: Brown the beef fry diced potato and onion together and melt cheddar on top.

name: Beef Bolognese
steps: Brown beef with onion carrot and garlic then simmer with tomatoes and serve over pasta.

name: Chickpea Salad
steps: Toss everything together with lemon juice and oil.

name: Spinach and Feta Wrap
steps: Scramble the egg with spinach and feta and roll in a tortilla.

name: Milk Rice Pudding
steps: Simmer rice slowly in milk with sugar and a strip of lemon zest.

name: Overnight Oats
steps: Stir oats with milk and yogurt and top with grated apple then chill overnight.

name: Apple Oat Crumble
steps: Bake sliced apple under a topping of oats butter and sugar.

name: Banana Bread
steps: Mash bananas mix with egg butter flour and sugar and bake in a loaf tin.

name: Ginger Carrot Soup
steps: Simmer carrot onion and ginger in stock blend and swirl in yogurt.

name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
steps: Stuff the peppers with browned beef rice and tomato and bake topped with cheese.

name: Salmon Fried Rice
steps: Flake cooked salmon into fried rice with egg peas and soy sauce.

name: Shrimp and Avocado Salad
steps: Sear the shrimp and toss with leaves avocado cucumber and lemon.

name: Garlic Bread Soup Croutons
steps: Cube the bread and toast with garlic butter and parsley.

name: Broccoli and Cheddar Soup
steps: Simmer broccoli potato and onion in stock blend and stir in milk and cheddar.

name: Mushroom and Spinach Omelette
steps: Saute mushrooms and spinach and fold into an omelette with parmesan.

name: Lettuce Wraps with Chicken
steps: Fry minced chicken with ginger and soy sauce and spoon into lettuce leaves with carrot.

name: Coconut Lentil Dal
steps: Simmer lentils in coconut milk with aromatics and stir in spinach at the end.

name: Green Bean and Potato Salad
steps: Boil potato and beans then toss with onion lemon and parsley.

name: Cream of Mushroom Toast
steps: Cook mushrooms in garlic and cream and pile on toasted bread.

name: Sausage Pasta Bake
steps: Mix browned sausage with pasta tomato and onion top with mozzarella and bake.

name: Sweet Potato Black Bean Bowl
steps: Roast the sweet potato and serve over beans with avocado cilantro and lemon.

name: Ham and Pea Pasta
steps: Toss cooked pasta with ham peas cream and parmesan.
